vi: Dự đoán bytes scanned từ Terraform config: bảng không partition scan toàn bảng (đắt), bảng partition theo ngày scan chỉ một partition (rẻ 100x).
Thiết kế partition + clustering (khối time_partitioning + clustering arguments) để trigger partition pruning, giảm bytes scanned.
Áp dụng require_partition_filter = true để chặn accidental full-table scan, bắt buộc WHERE clause contain partition key.
So sánh cost model: on-demand tinh phí per byte scanned (6.25 USD/TB), slot reservation mua compute committed (tiết kiệm khi query nhiều).
Thiết kế partition expiration (partition_expiration_days) cho time-series data, tự động xoá partition cũ để kiểm soát chi phí.
en: Predict bytes scanned from Terraform config: non-partitioned table scans the whole table (expensive), partitioned-by-day table scans one partition (100x cheaper).
Design partition + clustering (time_partitioning block + clustering arguments) to enable partition pruning, reducing bytes scanned.
Apply require_partition_filter = true to block accidental full-table scans, enforcing WHERE clause to contain the partition key.
Compare cost models: on-demand charges per byte scanned (6.25 USD/TB), slot reservation buys committed compute (saves when querying heavily).
Design partition expiration (partition_expiration_days) for time-series data, auto-deleting old partitions to control cost.
